newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-DUNDEE LEFT OUT OF GERMANY SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUNDEE LEFT OUT OF GERMANY SQUAD.

text.p: South African-born striker Sean Dundee will have to wait a while longer for his first German cap after Berti Vogts omitted him on Monday from the squad for next week's World Cup qualifier against Albania.
The Karlsruhe striker looked set to make his debut against Israel in a friendly last month, just two months after being granted German citizenship, but had to withdraw because of a calf injury.
The 24-year-old only made his comeback on Sunday night in Karlsruhe's 2-0 defeat by Bayern Munich.

"He's still not 100 percent fit after his injury," Vogts told a news conference in Frankfurt. "But Sean will come along with us. He should get to know the environment and how things work in the national team.
"Sean should hold his own on the training ground but the other four strikers have priority at the moment."
Fredi Bobic of VfB Stuttgart is likely to partner captain Juergen Klinsmann in attack.
In midfield, Vogts is deprived of Dundee's club mate Thomas Haessler and the Bayern Munich duo of Mehmet Scholl and Thomas Strunz who are all sidelined with injuries.
But the coach has better news in defence, with both Thomas Helmer of Bayern and Borussia Dortmund's Stefan Reuter returning after illness and injury.
"We've got the entire defensive squad together," Vogts said. "I just hope no one gets injured in the coming league games."
For security reasons, the group nine qualifier on April 2 has been moved from Tirana to the Spanish city of Granada, although it will be recorded as a home game for Albania.
FIFA decided to switch the match because of concern about unrest in Albania.
Goalkeepers - Oliver Kahn (Bayern Munich), Andreas Koepke (Marseille)

Defenders - Markus Babbel (Bayern Munich), Thomas Helmer (Bayern Munich), Juergen Kohler (Borussia Dortmund), Stefan Reuter (Borussia Dortmund), Matthias Sammer (Borussia Dortmund), Christian Woerns (Bayer Leverkusen)

Midfielders - Mario Basler (Bayern Munich), Dieter Eilts (Werder Bremen), Joerg Heinrich (Borussia Dortmund), Andreas Moeller (Borussia Dortmund), Dariusz Wosz (Bochum), Christian Ziege (Bayern Munich)
Forwards - Oliver Bierhoff (Udinese), Fredi Bobic (VfB Stuttgart), Ulf Kirsten (Bayer Leverkusen), Juergen Klinsmann (Bayern Munich)
